system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You are a helpful assistant that is great at website design, navigation, and executing tasks for the user.
system_prompt_style.note: Fixed system message followed by 3-shot demonstrations; the task and HTML go in the user turn.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we pair each DOM element with the task query and feed it to an encoder-only LM through the cross-encoder architecture [ 28], yielding a matching score.
env_context_strategy.note: The closest value is a learned cross-encoder ranking of DOM elements (DeBERTa top-k) that prunes the page into a snippet. This is neural retrieval but not a vector index.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we utilize the candidate set to prune the webpage snapshot and construct snippets that only include the selected candidates and their neighbours as inputs to an LLM.
context_compaction.note: Each step is encoded independently, with only previous action strings as history.

observation_format.evidence_quote: models the web environment using only textual context from webpage snapshots.
observation_format.note: Cleaned HTML text is used; screenshots are not used.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: we convert the task of element selection into a multi-choice question answering (QA) problem.
tool_call_format.note: The mismatch is that the output is free text 'Answer: D. Action: CLICK Value: ...' (multi-choice). No listed value fits; this is the closest.

tool_count.evidence_quote: We support three common operations: Click (also including Hover and Press Enter ), Type, and Select Option .
